stem: A dehumidifier reports normal operation, but humidity rises only in one dense canopy zone while nearby verified sensors remain controlled. Which next check has the highest diagnostic value?
choices: Compare local airflow and spatial moisture-load evidence before declaring a capacity failure
Lower the whole-room humidity setpoint as far as possible
Ignore the local sensor because the equipment says it is running
rationale: Localized response can reflect airflow or distribution rather than whole-system capacity. Spatial evidence helps distinguish distribution from equipment or measurement failure.
